title: The Tale of King Yunan and the Sage Duban

paragraphs.en: Once upon a time, in Persia's province of Zuman, there reigned a king named Yunan who suffered from leprosy. Despite the efforts of physicians and sages, his condition remained incurable. One day, a sage called Duban arrived in King Yunan’s city.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，在波斯的祖曼省，有一位名叫云南的国王，他患上了麻风病。尽管医生和圣贤尽了全力，他的病情依旧无法治愈。有一天，一位名为杜班的圣贤来到了云南国王的城市。

paragraphs.en: Duban was well-versed in various sciences, including philosophy and plant lore.
paragraphs.zh: 杜班通晓各种学问，包括哲学和植物学。

paragraphs.en: A few days after his arrival, Duban heard about the king's illness and the failure of medical treatments. The next morning, he approached the king, offering to cure him without medicine or ointment. Impressed by this claim, King Yunan promised riches and friendship if Duban succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 几天后，杜班听说国王生病了，药物治疗也未能见效。第二天一早，他便找到国王，表示可以不靠药膏或药物为国王治病。国王被这番话打动，若杜班真的能治好他的病，他承诺会给杜班丰厚的财富和友谊。

paragraphs.en: He then asked how it would be done.
paragraphs.zh: 然后他询问具体该怎么做。

paragraphs.en: Duban replied that he would treat the king externally. Astonished, the king agreed. The following day, Duban prepared a mallet with a hollow handle filled with medicines and a ball.
paragraphs.zh: 杜班回答说他会从外部为国王治疗。国王惊讶之余欣然同意。第二天，杜班准备了一个中空的手柄木槌，并在里面装满了药物，还配有一个小球。

paragraphs.en: After completing his preparations, he returned to the palace and kissed the ground before King Yunan.
paragraphs.zh: 准备就绪后，他回到宫殿，在云安王面前叩首拜ground。

paragraphs.en: Dinarzad urged her sister Shahrazad: "Please finish the story of the fisherman and the demon." Shahrazad agreed, recounting:
paragraphs.zh: 迪纳兹达催促她的妹妹沙赫拉兹黛：“请把渔夫和妖魔的故事说完吧。”沙赫拉兹黛应允了，讲述道：

paragraphs.en: The sage Duban approached King Yunan with a proposal to play ball. The king, accompanied by his courtiers, rode out to the playground. After receiving the mallet from Duban, the king raced, holding it tightly until he perspired.
paragraphs.zh: 圣贤杜班向云安王提议玩球游戏。云安王带着朝臣骑马来到球场。接过杜班递来的球棍后，云安王紧紧握住，跑了起来，额头上渐渐渗出了汗珠。

paragraphs.en: The medicine from the handle spread through his body. Following Duban's advice, the king bathed and slept, waking cured.
paragraphs.zh: 药力从把手处传遍全身。遵照杜班的建议，国王洗浴后入睡，次日痊愈醒来。

paragraphs.en: Duban returned home that night but visited the palace early next morning. He kissed the ground before King Yunan and recited:
paragraphs.zh: 杜班当晚回到家，第二天一早便前往王宫。他跪吻了地面，然后对云安王诵读道：

paragraphs.en: Your virtues are great; who else could have sired them? Your radiant face banishes the dark night.
paragraphs.zh: 你的美德如此高尚，又有谁能孕育出这样的品质？你那光彩照人的面容，驱散了黑暗的夜幕。

paragraphs.en: King Yunan stood and embraced Sage Duban after he recited his verses. The king then seated Duban beside him, engaging in attentive conversation. Grateful for the sage's healing verse, King Yunan bestowed honor upon him with gifts and endowments, granting his wishes.
paragraphs.zh: 云安王站起身来，拥抱了诗仙杜班。随后请他入座，两人展开了一番专注的交谈。为了感谢杜班的疗愈诗句，云安王赐予他丰厚的礼物和恩典，并满足了他的心愿。

paragraphs.en: The previous night, after a bath, the king found himself cured of leprosy, feeling extremely happy and generous.
paragraphs.zh: 昨晚洗完澡后，国王发现自己治好了麻风病，心情异常愉快，显得格外慷慨。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, as he sat on his throne in the reception hall, surrounded by Mamluks, chamberlains, viziers, lords, and Sage Duban, King Yunan stood up to embrace and seat the sage. They drank and ate together with great attentiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，云安王坐在接见厅的宝座上，周围簇拥着马穆鲁克、内臣、宰相、贵族和圣者杜班。云安王起身迎接圣者，亲自为他安排座位。他们一起饮酒进食，举止恭敬而专注。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad did not speak. Her sister Dinarzad remarked, "Sister, what a lovely story!" Shahrazad replied, "The rest is stranger and more amazing.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙赫拉兹德没有说话。她的妹妹迪纳兹德说道：“姐姐，这个故事真精彩！”沙赫拉兹德回答说：“剩下的部分更奇妙，更加不可思议。”

paragraphs.en: If the king spares me tomorrow night, I will tell you something even more entertaining."
paragraphs.zh: 如果国王明天晚上饶了我，我会告诉你一个更加有趣的故事。

paragraphs.en: King Yunan was impressed by Sage Duban's abilities and rewarded him generously. At dusk, after giving him a thousand dinars, the king decided to keep Duban as his companion and confidant.
paragraphs.zh: 云安王对杜班的能力十分赏识，给予了丰厚的奖赏。日落时分，在给了他一千第纳尔之后，国王决定将杜班留作自己的伴友和知己。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, King Yunan sat on his throne in the reception hall, surrounded by his officers. He called for Sage Duban, who entered humbly and kissed the ground before the king. The king stood up to greet him, seated him beside himself, and invited him to share a meal.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，云安王坐在接见厅的宝座上，周围簇拥着文武百官。他召唤圣者杜班，杜班谦逊地走进来，在国王面前叩首。云安王起身相迎，请他入座自己的身旁，并邀请他共进早餐。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the day, they conversed freely, and at nightfall, the king ordered another thousand dinars for Duban.
paragraphs.zh: 白天他们畅所欲言，夜幕降临后，国王又给了杜班一千第纳尔。

paragraphs.en: Sage Duban returned home that evening, feeling grateful and content with his new friendship and the king's generosity.
paragraphs.zh: 苏班贤士当晚回到了家中，心中充满了感激和满足感，新结下的友谊以及国王的慷慨令他倍感温馨。

paragraphs.en: In the morning, King Yunan went to the royal reception hall, where princes and viziers stood in attendance. A greedy and envious vizier feared that the sage Duban's favor with the king might lead to his dismissal. He approached the king, kissing the ground before him, and said, "O excellent King and glorious Lord, if I fail to advise you on a grave matter, I am not my father’s son."
paragraphs.zh: 清晨，云安王前往朝堂，众王子和大臣恭候一旁。一个贪婪且嫉妒的大臣担心云安王对圣者杜班的恩宠会让自己被罢黜。他跪地吻地，上前对云安王说道：“啊，贤明的君主光辉的陛下，若我未能向您进言一件关乎重大的事务，那我就不是我父亲的儿子了。”

paragraphs.en: The king was upset and asked, "Damn you, what advice have you got?" The vizier replied, "Your Majesty, ‘He who considers not the end, fortune is not his friend.’ You have bestowed favors on your enemy, who seeks to destroy your power and steal your wealth.
paragraphs.zh: 国王气愤地说：“该死，你有什么好主意？”宰相回答道：“陛下，‘不虑长远者，非谋之徒也。’您对敌人施恩，而他们却图谋削弱您的权力、窃取您的财富。”

paragraphs.en: I fear he will do you harm."
paragraphs.zh: 我怕他会对你不利。

paragraphs.en: The king asked, "Whom do you accuse? Who are you pointing at?" The vizier replied, "I point the finger at the sage Duban from Byzantium."
paragraphs.zh: 国王问道：“你指控的是谁？你在指着谁？”首相回答道：“我指责的是来自拜占庭的圣人杜班。”

paragraphs.en: King Yunan retorted, "Damn you, is he my enemy? He is the most faithful and favored of people. This sage cured me with a simple gesture and has rendered physicians and sages helpless.
paragraphs.zh: 云安王反驳道：“你给我闭嘴，他可是我的亲信？他是最受我信任和宠爱的人。这位圣人仅凭一个手势就治好了我的病，让医生和智者都束手无策。”

paragraphs.en: I will give him a thousand dinars every month in addition to his regular salary. Even if I were to share my wealth and kingdom with him, it would be less than he deserves." The king suspected the vizier's envy and compared the situation to one from a story told by King Sindbad’s vizier, where a king wanted to kill his own son out of jealousy.
paragraphs.zh: 我除了他的正常薪酬外，每个月还会给他一千第纳尔。即使我把我的财富和王位都分给他，也远远不够他应得的。“国王怀疑首相的嫉妒之心，联想到辛巴德国王的首相曾讲过的一个故事，在那个故事里，一位君主因嫉妒而想要杀死自己的儿子。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad and her sister Dinarzad lay down in bed. Dinarzad said, "Sister, please tell us one of your stories." Shahrazad agreed: "Very well."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹和她的妹妹迪纳兹扎德躺在床上。迪纳兹扎德说：“姐姐，请给我们讲一个你的故事吧。”沙赫拉兹答应了：“好吧。”

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad began: "I heard that King Yunan's vizier asked him a question. The vizier inquired about what King Sindbad’s vizier had told the king when he wanted to kill his own son. King Yunan replied, 'When provoked by an envious man, King Sindbad's vizier said, "Don't do something you will regret later."
paragraphs.zh: 沙赫拉兹阿德说道：“我听说国王尤南的首相向他提出了一个问题。首相询问当辛巴达国王欲杀掉自己儿子时，辛巴达国王的首相曾对国王说了些什么。尤南国王回答道：‘当被一个嫉妒的人激怒时，辛巴达国王的首相说，“不要做你会日后后悔的事。”’”
"上次见面真是好久不见啊！"
